simple.meaning: צָנִין (tsânîyn) is a Hebrew word meaning “a thorn.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: צָנִין (H6796) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Numbers 33:55, with occurrences in Numbers, Joshua.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to צָנִין (H6796) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in צָנִין (H6796) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: צָנִין (tsânîyn) / H6796 is traced through Numbers 33:55, Joshua 23:13 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
